readerCopy.body: The first boundary can carry every boundary that was never set when anger has been unacceptable for too long. When Mars squares Lilith, action and refusal create friction, allowing a current frustration to collide with years of swallowed noes, softened objections, or unwanted accommodation. The anger may accurately describe the pattern while exaggerating what one moment can repair. Today's boundary becomes clearer when it is not forced to carry the entire backlog.
